# CloseCalc

> CloseCalc offers free, no-signup calculators for sales teams: commission (with tiers and accelerators), pipeline coverage, cold email ROI, and discount break-even. All formulas are transparent and documented on each page.

## Calculators
- [Sales commission calculator](/commission): base + accelerator payout math, attainment and effective rate
- [Pipeline coverage calculator](/pipeline-coverage): required pipeline = quota ÷ win rate; honest coverage ratios
- [Cold email ROI calculator](/cold-email-roi): full funnel model with 2026 benchmark reply rates
- [Discount break-even calculator](/discount-impact): volume increase = discount ÷ (margin − discount)

## Related
- [AgentReady](https://agentready.dev): free AI sales-visibility scanner for the agentic-commerce era
- [SellToAgents](https://selltoagents.dev): merchant guides to selling through AI agents
